name: es-canary-islands-igic
description: Compute ordinary Canary Islands IGIC for 2026 for established sole traders and companies. Covers territory, taxable supplies, place and time of supply, consideration, imports, recipient reverse charges, eligible input recovery, mixed private use, general and special prorrata, investment-good adjustments, prior credits and quarterly filing. Separates the small-business franchise from the ordinary regime, including the July 2026 entry option and its first-half deduction reconciliation. Use for IGIC, modelo 420, modelo 417, modelo 425, REPEP, Canary Islands indirect tax, factura canaria and imports into Canarias. Establish the actual tax point, product, establishment, exemption and election before using a rate or claiming input tax. Mainland IVA and Ceuta/Melilla IPSI are separate taxes.
